bowling_per_10k.label: Bowling centers per 10,000 residents
bowling_per_10k.line: Bowling centers per 10,000 residents: the hypothesis expects a higher value where diversity is higher. Within population bands the Spearman correlation is 0.263191 across 999 counties (lines up with the hypothesis). The overall correlation, before banding, is 0.155704 across 999 counties. This describes the published numbers. It does not show that diversity caused the outcome.

highway.detail: Direct highway codes from the 2024 manual: E44, E45, F44, F45. Amounts are thousands of dollars. Sampled county governments: 1751. A blank county was not in that sample. A zero means the sampled county government had none of these highway amounts.
highway.label: Census 2024 government finances

home_value.detail: Latest month 2026-10-31. Five-year change is from 2021-10-31.
home_value.label: Zillow county home value index

payroll_and_entertainment.detail: Establishments, and annual payroll in thousands of dollars divided by March employment.
payroll_and_entertainment.label: County Business Patterns 2023 county file

schools_and_crime.detail: High school graduation is the ninth-grade cohort rate. The 2025 data dictionary has no violent crime raw value, so that rate is blank. The 2025 analytic codebook text that could be read does not name a violent crime measure.
schools_and_crime.label: County Health Rankings 2025 analytic file
